seoTitle: Create Discount Codes in Squarespace (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Set up percentage, fixed-amount, or free shipping discount codes in Squarespace with rules, triggers, and expiry dates for your next promotion.
intro: Offering promo codes is one of the easiest ways to drive sales in a Squarespace store. This guide walks through building a discount from scratch — choosing the offer type, setting trigger conditions, and scheduling when it runs.

steps.heading: Log in and open Discounts
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, select your site, then go to the Products and Services panel and click Discounts to manage promotions.

steps.heading: Add a new discount and pick a type
steps.body: Click Add Discount and choose percentage-off, fixed-amount, or free shipping, depending on your campaign goal.

steps.heading: Enter discount details and a trigger
steps.body: Name your discount, add the promo code and description, then set the trigger — a minimum spend, a code entered at checkout, or specific order conditions.

steps.heading: Set product and usage rules
steps.body: Decide whether the discount applies sitewide or to specific products, and configure any usage limits per customer.

steps.heading: Set dates and save
steps.body: Add a start and expiry date to match a sale event, review everything, then click Save to make the discount live at checkout.

faq.question: What types of discounts can I create in Squarespace?
faq.answer: You can create percentage-off discounts, fixed-amount coupons, or free shipping offers.

faq.question: Can I limit a discount to specific products?
faq.answer: Yes, you can apply a discount sitewide or restrict it to specific categories or individual products.

faq.question: Can I schedule a discount to start and end automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, you set a start date and expiration date so the discount activates and deactivates on its own.

faq.question: Do I need a promo code for every discount?
faq.answer: Not necessarily — you can trigger a discount by a minimum spend or order condition instead of requiring a code at checkout.
